task.title: Upgrade and rollback
task.shortdesc: Upgrades repeat the full installation; roll back if verification fails.

taskbody.context: Roll back if the health check or smoke test fails and cannot be fixed within the maintenance window.

step.cmd: Stop the service: sudo systemctl stop ccs.
Restore the backup made before installation.
Start the service and repeat the health check.
Record the rollback and its reason in the CM log.
